targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: Is the best model enough, or is the real moat distribution and control?

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The simple version is this: the advantage a lab builds when its model, data, distribution, and ecosystem make it hard to replace.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The scary part is not the average result. It is the person, patient, team, or company living inside the exception.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: Lovely. We have automated the decision and preserved the blame. Very efficient, in the bleakest possible sense.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: Think of it like a castle built from distribution, data, habit, and switching costs instead of stone.

targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: The question for tomorrow is not whether model moat sounds clever. It is who gets caught when it becomes real.
